N2 filesystem-check.ts:67-68: a local repo whose folder is gone reports "'X' is not a git repository" — the plan's 'folder moved' case gets a misleading reason.
N3 SettingsFilesystems.tsx:275 labels every token connection 'GitHub' (two GitHub tokens are indistinguishable); :417 shows 'Connection: <raw uuid>'.
N4 The dialog filters connections case-insensitively while routes/filesystems.ts:175 requires exactly 'github' and service is free text — an offered option can 400.

N5 markNeedsAttention being optional on the port means an unwired port turns each held request into a per-tick retry forever; boot always wires it, so production is safe, but the contract no longer enforces it.
N6 SetupFlow.tsx registerFilesystemAndInject swallows every per-agent failure — onboarding can still silently finish with a filesystem picked for nobody (break #2's exact shape) with nothing shown.

defects.fix: use a separator that is not a control character (e.g. the unit separator \u001f, or JSON.stringify of the pair)

comparisonRun.incident: the orchestrator spawned a second agent for the main comparison while the first was still doing it. The first agent's script began with `pkill -f ba5-harness-main`, which killed the second's lane one second in (exit 144 = killed by signal). Lesson: check for a live agent before spawning another for the same job.
comparisonRun.resolution: stopped the second agent; kept the surviving lane (pid 57994) at f88b71434 in /private/tmp/ba5-harness-main, running on the node_modules the stopped agent's npm ci had already produced at the same commit; armed an orchestrator-owned watcher on its log so the result survives the agent dropping again
comparisonRun.mainResult: origin/main f88b71434, 04:47:01-05:19:24 CEST (~32 min), exit 1: 4 files failed / 14 passed; 8 tests failed / 83 passed / 2 skipped — identical counts to the branch
comparisonRun.verdict: NOT caused by this branch. 7 of 8 failing test names are identical on main and the branch (claude-code adapter, cursor-agent adapter, model-options claude effort, session-handles claude-code/codex x2/cursor-agent). The 8th is the same file and same harness (opencode knowledge-tree-real) but a different case on each side, which is flakiness within that file, not a regression. This matches the blast-radius finding: the branch changes zero files under layers/agent-execution.
